desc: Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Newspaper Publication with respect to information pertaining to 37th Annual General Meeting of the Company
This is to inform that the Company has successfully completed the acquisition of 100% Issued Share Capital of M/s. Owens Springs Limited.
Intimation of 60th Annual General Meeting, Book Closure Dates and Record Date.
Reg 34(1) - Annual Report of Akar Auto Industries Limited for the Financial year 2025-2026
Notice of 37th Annual General Meeting of Akar Auto Industries Limited to be held on 29th September, 2026

Corporate action fixing book closure for 37th Annual General Meeting of Akar Auto Industries Limited and fixing of Record date for reckoning shareholders who are eligible for payment of Dividend if any declared at the ensuring Annual General Meeting
The Company has Fixed Tuesday, September 22, 2026 as the Record date for reckoning the shareholders entitle for final dividend if any declared at the Annual General Meeting of the Company
Please find attached corporate action for Final Dividend, If approved at the 60th AGM.
